# Netline UI

This is the documentation for the Netline UI design system package.
Netline UI is built on top of Material UI (MUI) and extends it with
additional components like DataGrid and custom DatePickers.

For MUI-based components, refer to Material UI documentation for base functionality.
Netline UI components may have additional props and customizations.

Package: https://github.com/lsy-netline/netline-ui
Storybook: https://netline-ui-storybook-next.aks-netline.dev.lhsystems.int

## Material UI Reference

Many Netline UI components are based on Material UI. For detailed MUI documentation:

- [MUI Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/): Official Material UI documentation
- [MUI llms.txt](https://mui.com/material-ui/llms.txt): MUI documentation for LLMs
- [MUI MCP](https://mui.com/material-ui/getting-started/mcp/): MUI Model Context Protocol server

## Component Base Libraries

| Component Type | Base Library | Documentation Source |
|---------------|--------------|----------------------|
| Standard inputs, layout, navigation | Material UI | MUI MCP → Local overrides |
| DataGrid components | MUI X DataGrid | MUI MCP → Local overrides |
| Date/Time pickers | Netline UI Custom | Local markdown docs |
| Utilities (Logger, ServiceFactory) | Netline UI Custom | Local markdown docs |

## Installation

```bash
# Add to .npmrc for private registry access
@lsy-netline:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com

# Install the package
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
import { Button, TextField, DataGrid } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
import { DatePicker } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui/pickers';

function MyComponent() {
  return (
    <div>
      <Button variant="contained">Click me</Button>
      <TextField label="Name" />
      <DatePicker label="Select date" />
    </div>
  );
}
```
